_meta.design: Wave 3 — the discovery doctrine. Waves 1-2 built the sanctioned mutation verbs (regate: a gate's CONTENT changes only through rigor; detach: a dependency CLAIM is retractable, loudly). This wave ships the doctrine that tells a planner WHEN those verbs are the answer — plan only to the knowledge horizon, end the horizon with an explicit replan point, treat replanning as a sanctioned OUTCOME of refutation — plus the ONE runtime surface the plan refuter proved missing: the loud side of the editability boundary. Round 1 demonstrated a hand-edited completed gate's criteria is SILENT on every channel of both runtimes (doctor keys only on regate events a hand-edit never writes; unsanctioned_drift is WATCH_PATHS-based; stale-pass needs a rearm), so DS1 is spec-first feature work for the drift tripwire — doctor compares each ever-passed gate's current dag criteria against the criteria pinned on its last PROVENANCED gate_passed, a mismatch with no sanctioning gate_regated after that pass is an unsanctioned-criteria-drift finding, bare/import passes are skipped — alongside the characterization of what round 1 CONFIRMED already works (append-continuation runtime-agreed; unstarted surface silently editable; edges loud and parity-identical; detach/reattach compose at the replan point). DS2 ships the words: the skill's horizon rule + replan-as-refutation-outcome, the gated how-to docs/howto/plan-to-the-horizon.md with every claim anchored to T184, and docs current-state. F8 the last-pin-vs-current tripwire is launderable in one command (hand-weaken then plainly re-run the gate: the fresh pass pins the weakened criteria, pin==current forever) — respecced to CONSECUTIVE-PIN comparison over the whole log (any adjacent pin-pair difference, or last-pin-vs-current-dag difference, with no sanctioning gate_regated between those two points = drift; the log remembers the launder forever); F9 bare/import passes could shadow the pin — respecced: the pin sequence is the CRITERIA-PINNED passes only, bare passes are never pins (the staleRearm precedent), terminology fixed (criteria-pinned, not provenanced); F10 comparison semantics pinned — identity is the ORDERED sequence of (id, cmd) pairs byte-exact (reorder = drift, cmd byte change = drift, criterion add/remove = drift, an ever-passed gate REMOVED from the dag = drift; desc/timeout_s are NOT pinned by the gate runners and are an HONEST LIMIT recorded in parity-notes and the how-to — a timeout_s-only edit is invisible to the tripwire by design, never asserted as drift); F11 severity pinned: a doctor PROBLEM (tampered state, house precedent — exit 1; no existing fixture collides); F12 the loudness reaches the sweep and the tick — gate.sh --all counts drifted gates FAILING (the pending-regate precedent) and the ticks' doctor filter widens to surface drift problems as the EXISTING unsanctioned_drift reason key (no new PROTOCOL keys).
